svg.title: embpy architecture
svg.desc: Biological entities are resolved and preprocessed, dispatched through BioEmbedder to one of ~150 registered models, and written into AnnData slots; annotation and analysis modules build on the output.
svg.text: one embedding API across every biological modality
A single call resolves an identifier, routes it to the right model family, and writes embeddings into the correct AnnData slot with provenance.
